parameters.query:
-- Up to 20 items per run, newest first, so a backlog clears over a few runs
-- instead of one long run that overlaps the next.
--
-- A source that does not allow summaries is copyright, not quality: those
-- items go to a person instead and are never sent to the model, even when an
-- editor asked.
--
-- When the queue leaves room, summaries made with an earlier instruction are
-- made again, newest first, so every article gets its Finnish title and event
-- details (db/init/21-titles-events.sql). Those articles stay summarised
-- meanwhile, and nobody is told about them on Telegram again.
WITH held AS (
    UPDATE items i
       SET status = 'manual',
           status_reason = 'the source does not allow AI summaries, handle by hand'
      FROM sources s
     WHERE s.id = i.source_id
       AND i.status = 'queued'
       AND NOT s.summarization_allowed
    RETURNING i.id
),
queued AS (
    SELECT i.id, i.title, i.raw_text, coalesce(i.published_at, i.fetched_at) AS published, FALSE AS refresh
      FROM items i
      LEFT JOIN sources s ON s.id = i.source_id
     WHERE i.status = 'queued'
       AND coalesce(s.summarization_allowed, TRUE)
     ORDER BY coalesce(i.published_at, i.fetched_at) DESC
     LIMIT 20
),
older AS (
    SELECT i.id, i.title, i.raw_text, coalesce(i.published_at, i.fetched_at) AS published, TRUE AS refresh
      FROM items i
      JOIN summaries sm   ON sm.item_id = i.id AND sm.language = 'fi'
      LEFT JOIN sources s ON s.id = i.source_id
     WHERE i.status = 'summarised'
       AND sm.version < 2
       AND coalesce(s.summarization_allowed, TRUE)
       AND length(coalesce(i.raw_text, '')) >= (SELECT value::int FROM app_settings WHERE key = 'filter_min_text_chars')
     ORDER BY i.created_at DESC
     LIMIT 20
)
SELECT x.id, x.title, x.raw_text, x.refresh,
       to_char(x.published AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Helsinki', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS published,
       (SELECT value FROM app_settings WHERE key = 'llm_provider') AS llm_provider,
       (SELECT value FROM app_settings WHERE key = 'llm_base_url') AS llm_base_url
  FROM (SELECT * FROM queued UNION ALL SELECT * FROM older) x
 ORDER BY x.refresh, x.published DESC
 LIMIT 20;

-- One statement, so an item is never marked summarised without a summary.
-- A failed call is written down with its reason instead of leaving the item
-- looking as if it is still waiting. Link and publisher are added by the
-- database, see db/init/12-summaries.sql.
--
-- An older summary being made again ($12) leaves its article summarised
-- whatever happens. If the answer was no use, the old summary stays and is
-- marked done, so it is not asked about again every run; if the AI did not
-- answer at all, it is tried again later.
WITH s AS (
    INSERT INTO summaries (item_id, language, text, provider, model, title, event_starts,
                           event_ends, event_time, event_place, event_deadline, version)
    SELECT $1::bigint, 'fi', btrim($2), $3, $4, nullif($6, ''), nullif($7, '')::date,
           nullif($8, '')::date, nullif($9, ''), nullif($10, ''), nullif($11, '')::date, 2
     WHERE nullif(btrim($2), '') IS NOT NULL
    ON CONFLICT (item_id, language) DO UPDATE
       SET text = EXCLUDED.text, provider = EXCLUDED.provider, model = EXCLUDED.model,
           title = EXCLUDED.title, event_starts = EXCLUDED.event_starts,
           event_ends = EXCLUDED.event_ends, event_time = EXCLUDED.event_time,
           event_place = EXCLUDED.event_place, event_deadline = EXCLUDED.event_deadline,
           version = 2, generated_at = now()
    RETURNING item_id
),
given_up AS (
    UPDATE summaries SET version = 2
     WHERE item_id = $1::bigint AND language = 'fi'
       AND $12::boolean
       AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM s)
       AND $5 !~* '(ECONNREFUSED|ECONNRESET|ETIMEDOUT|ENOTFOUND|EAI_AGAIN|timed? ?out|socket hang up|status code (5[0-9]{2}|429))'
    RETURNING item_id
)
-- If the AI could not be reached at all, the article goes back to the queue
-- for the next run. Only an answer that was no use marks it failed.
UPDATE items
   SET status        = CASE WHEN $12::boolean THEN status
                            WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM s) THEN 'summarised'
                            WHEN $5 ~* '(ECONNREFUSED|ECONNRESET|ETIMEDOUT|ENOTFOUND|EAI_AGAIN|timed? ?out|socket hang up|status code (5[0-9]{2}|429))'
                              THEN 'queued'
                            ELSE 'summary_failed' END,
       status_reason = CASE WHEN $12::boolean OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM s) THEN status_reason
                            WHEN $5 ~* '(ECONNREFUSED|ECONNRESET|ETIMEDOUT|ENOTFOUND|EAI_AGAIN|timed? ?out|socket hang up|status code (5[0-9]{2}|429))'
                              THEN 'waiting for the AI to answer again'
                            ELSE left(coalesce(nullif($5, ''), 'the model returned no text'), 300) END
 WHERE id = $1::bigint
RETURNING id, status, status_reason, title, $12::boolean AS refresh,
          -- set when an editor sent this link to the bot
          (SELECT u.telegram_user_id FROM users u WHERE u.id = items.captured_by) AS telegram_user_id;
